scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api && npm run build:verification && npm run build:infra
scripts.build:verification: npm run build --workspace @agentpay/verify-node && npm run test:verification:extended
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint:go
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:go && npm run test:verification
scripts.test:verification: npm run test --workspace @agentpay/verify-node && node scripts/run-python-verification-tests.mjs && npm run test:verification:extended
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @agentpay/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @agentpay/verify-node && npm run typecheck --workspace @agentpay/infra
